name: Login from unfamiliar device, location or infrastructure
description: Session originates from a device, country, emulator or network not previously associated with the customer, including shortly after a phishing event.
fp: Travel, new phones and VPN use are common legitimate causes.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
